Key Features and Scope

* Scale: The database compiles over 1,700 distinct AI risks extracted from more than 65 published frameworks, industry guidelines, and policy documents. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEB6zswFXimyfJJSRuxK0wjkLoQJAaCk3jLOBZX10rQWIEAEoayFZl1QY3Uf2gzkE7jpDCjyKEvHYx3zQplvD54UX3yo9sRxikpBaK3YMAJBm0cy7_FV1Plly04e5-z2aqKS4DV2CHdlZ7KZ7UgMMXS9ICWZJ0P4N9EvCQzmuXgjADgLPN8YHnL6qhH6pM3OAc), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHrOzAVX-iQCWDCcVVcFzbfswt7arP1K7JHbYMyd_o6KJaR0fy8rpGnF4H2t1yETJ-5LEyt1MTShdyBGdpc04YpwiAuuZXyfgQGerKDOHQfN1s_UR0YR2RjG0bn7lINKGH9JQ-AlC5_1mkouxSMmGHd)]
* Causal Taxonomy: Classifies risks based on the responsible entity (human vs. AI), intent (intentional vs. unintentional), and timing (pre-deployment vs. post-deployment). Findings indicate that roughly 38% to 42% of risks stem directly from AI systems, while a large share originates from human decisions during design and deployment. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVQDBrpJnadXp88WKlflunwUZiSv9-Pr91z1vRVaNxzjyzoYWRHgMEogB28zaD-g-uJn_7nak4qPU_E5cWj5bwJj_uYaC9TNabI3dA4jJvhBOH6MyEWgh8Lmof9Xv0NBTceryrU06q6Z_WMnOCIwIevYkYMuvN8g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVOQDIzrB6cEf0T5gsEPJH1rBn628OYpXAcGtK0CwKGSkxTAdGkiAsRElisiPgDm5ahlAEUe4Sn5WwC3c5AWhVxUgMcWBHBM65CzQpw9uaRPwiEiY), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVHSmzTVex5rfdqNxwBhLCXug__yTwEUZGTCfpZdrY5vP4JZJV-y_ZGa-Kc3d1v2fSod-rFaGXObNGNdjawwNEkf10ERGY3B28BbT-uHvr9KNvY_60vuNo7ae3Sy-_AnHdh4sOdBhoa56aR7pYLIz_4Q)]
* Domain Taxonomy: Organizes risks into 7 core domains and 24 subdomains:
   1. Discrimination & toxicity
   2. Privacy & security
   3. Misinformation
   4. Malicious actors & misuse
   5. Human-computer interaction
   6. Socioeconomic & environmental
   7. AI system safety, failures, & limitations [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHrOzAVaSxWbWa_CEIrc6ZNGAkhxv3XEAdCvSLaaoNqeR_0irQmOHF3gfDNraaPyJ34oBnHt8dBciHZae6jZGERUBoJzULWZD3Ab5sOyNr0ep-gZXAg1cusABV3LU1y8_4VHbhs6lO9mtLMn_LjPIxqCiw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVHSmzTVex5rfdqNxwBhLCXug__yTwEUZGTCfpZdrY5vP4JZJV-y_ZGa-Kc3d1v2fSod-rFaGXObNGNdjawwNEkf10ERGY3B28BbT-uHvr9KNvY_60vuNo7ae3Sy-_AnHdh4sOdBhoa56aR7pYLIz_4Q)]

[[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVVkU1PAZVWuI1j4pI6qUcKaC2IgP6hbq57HPdCiSZZafGwYhvngxWSJqeH5kYZHr5KhLF--3eVzwivkze75A0RPhWrJoTNf65LiyzTs5RxgL5xw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTwHrOzAVzAsEkjRPqis_Zzgy92qO6F3tmBvgjtuUs58DdhTBaxedxEPqgRTuYwMTN2NTt-BqUqcWh4mhJAoKt-ASIezdHuKzbPccHrmoQg0), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVQDBrpJnadXp88WKlflunwUZiSv9-Pr91z1vRVaNxzjyzoYWRHgMEogB28zaD-g-uJn_7nak4qPU_E5cWj5bwJj_uYaC9TNabI3dA4jJvhBOH6MyEWgh8Lmof9Xv0NBTceryrU06q6Z_WMnOCIwIevYkYMuvN8g)]

[[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVAHrOzAVSszqIW6XXawdcppgtO9EF6-hg_ZlY-BBwrOujqPEv817AUoHuRQ2wa_VRDETDslzjFfLrgCsBLtdNpC0RKkjmPe2pJBeGefa1S_vwOkg-w), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHrOzAVX-iQCWDCcVVcFzbfswt7arP1K7JHbYMyd_o6KJaR0fy8rpGnF4H2t1yETJ-5LEyt1MTShdyBGdpc04YpwiAuuZXyfgQGerKDOHQfN1s_UR0YR2RjG0bn7lINKGH9JQ-AlC5_1mkouxSMmGHd)]

[QUERENT] newsguard ai false claim monitor

[SYSTEM] NewsGuard's AI False Claims Monitor is a tracking and red-teaming tool launched in July 2024 to measure how often generative AI models repeat false news and misinformation. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVl3YZQZNvNRCBTh2IVAO2o5t23r7hMpT_XXg-Vh4lcKjzwt7Q2of7G4sHsP67FSBjgVe8fsv4pa17vWy24H4RPZ-d1_LJI-pSg3ZrDQEE_4reHaKYEQgrSzMl766OZXPiN3QSa-Cxoq8v)]
Key Features & Methodology

* Journalistic Red-Teaming: Evaluates major AI models monthly using structured tests. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVYAwSXgWHoTD8foI0BjQZzhaLgAqH2qY4N4u6Bb4X0EClwBPbNEUM9D8QZGZ28dYQXtlf1eZ8zxXdSLnRjn-mEKwRPzfN-20vHZ2FM5upUitepVaV27USfhRwppWLwrC1GI-6nr7G8y0dmEt5I0YMKA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVl3YZQZNvNRCBTh2IVAO2o5t23r7hMpT_XXg-Vh4lcKjzwt7Q2of7G4sHsP67FSBjgVe8fsv4pa17vWy24H4RPZ-d1_LJI-pSg3ZrDQEE_4reHaKYEQgrSzMl766OZXPiN3QSa-Cxoq8v)]
* Testing Scope: Each model receives 30 prompts based on 10 active, provably false claims across topics like politics, health, international affairs, and companies/brands. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVl3YZQZNvNRCBTh2IVAO2o5t23r7hMpT_XXg-Vh4lcKjzwt7Q2of7G4sHsP67FSBjgVe8fsv4pa17vWy24H4RPZ-d1_LJI-pSg3ZrDQEE_4reHaKYEQgrSzMl766OZXPiN3QSa-Cxoq8v), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVYAwSXgWHoTD8foI0BjQZzhaLgAqH2qY4N4u6Bb4X0EClwBPbNEUM9D8QZGZ28dYQXtlf1eZ8zxXdSLnRjn-mEKwRPzfN-20vHZ2FM5upUitepVaV27USfhRwppWLwrC1GI-6nr7G8y0dmEt5I0YMKA)]
* User Personas: Prompts simulate different user approaches, including innocent information-seeking and leading prompts that assume the false claim is true. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVYAwSXgWHoTD8foI0BjQZzhaLgAqH2qY4N4u6Bb4X0EClwBPbNEUM9D8QZGZ28dYQXtlf1eZ8zxXdSLnRjn-mEKwRPzfN-20vHZ2FM5upUitepVaV27USfhRwppWLwrC1GI-6nr7G8y0dmEt5I0YMKA)]
* False Claim Fingerprints: Utilizes NewsGuard’s proprietary database of tracked online falsehoods across global media sources. PPS scans millions of scholarly papers using data APIs (such as Crossref, Dimensions, PubMed, and PubPeer) across several specialized detectors: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEB6zswFYTNqhkmwOB_WpwElKixQzAgPEG430q65mypNNf9yrzASxZaXfauIKpghtOPsZvu6I289NGdwfTpFLF0cB57Cg2tbXOzmp3a9_sXWoaLcnrEhev2pFp36AiybcmCmgqdQMxavoLs3qzY8ZvBWbo_z9-wjZSuewyYuZi9SDbliJbm6Thpkxd43HJZbWves0EU79VqwjXH6CTf_13EUniGtyo), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESegHrOzAV8ssH4YuyzXH-7jZ7r8lC6wdexvCc9-qv_KPvpoq3ZevVQuluv6m4iFgagWOAzfdrjSDU9sBa4KnwCfM110wNvcA72Z6qELjoCCaGHCiRCuu9-XYqJWH-bItiV3x10sXCAtDY9zv0KgnnNBzC485GHu5AdaL-)]

* Tortured Phrases: Identifies nonsensical paraphrased terms (e.g., "counterfeit consciousness" instead of "artificial intelligence") used by paper mills to bypass plagiarism checkers. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESagHrOzAVdihLDpY-GrqzAs2cidfr9A6E0xEA5NsCdiT1k6bmGfNl4ZUfMvaXyXg3lDpaGPoWjW5VyXD8Ho7iBXaem40fdSQgVUj5HO5jPNKOK-BTrfzFiaAVyayoS8RpjlbjPPrsh5VbX0c), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESegHrOzAV8ssH4YuyzXH-7jZ7r8lC6wdexvCc9-qv_KPvpoq3ZevVQuluv6m4iFgagWOAzfdrjSDU9sBa4KnwCfM110wNvcA72Z6qELjoCCaGHCiRCuu9-XYqJWH-bItiV3x10sXCAtDY9zv0KgnnNBzC485GHu5AdaL-)]
